products.title: Mahjong Mat, DOMINO OXBLOOD
products.body_html:
First introduced in our tabletop collection, Domino Oxblood quickly became one of our favorite patterns. Reimagined as a mahjong mat, it brings the same warmth, symmetry, and collected feeling to game night. Rich oxblood, flowing botanical ribbons, and delicate hidden tigers create a table that feels as beautiful between games as it does during them.

 

Designed to complement both traditional and contemporary interiors, Domino Oxblood transforms the game into part of the room. Crafted in our signature PLAYFINISH™ faux leather, it offers a refined playing surface that wipes clean with ease while softening the sound of tiles in play.

WHAT COLOR IS IT? Depends on the light- in bright light it is dark burgundy, under lower lighting conditions it is brown with a hint of red.

Features

  • Original artwork by Tigre de Tartán
  • Exclusive PLAYFINISH™ faux leather playing surface
  • Poly cotton backing- VERY THIN PROFILE
  • Softens tile noise while protecting your table
  • Water-resistant and wipeable
  • Rolls for easy storage and travel
  • 31.5" × 31.5"

About PLAYFINISH™

Our signature PLAYFINISH™ faux leather was developed to bridge the gap between function and decoration. Unlike fabric mats that wrinkle or felt mats that absorb spills, PLAYFINISH™ provides a smooth, durable surface that wipes clean in seconds while maintaining the richness and structure of a luxury tabletop.

Every Tigre de Tartán mat begins as original artwork, thoughtfully designed to become part of the home long after the last tile has been pushed. Whether layered beneath a spirited game or left out between gatherings, our mats are designed to make the table feel beautifully dressed.

products.title: Mahjong Mat, FRENCH MURAL
products.body_html:
French Mural is inspired by the hand-painted scenic wallpapers that once wrapped the walls of grand French country homes. Towering trees, softened by time and sunlight, create the illusion that your Mahjong table has been placed in the middle of an enchanted garden.

 

A dreamy playing field floats quietly at the center, allowing your tiles to shine while framing every game with an immersive landscape. Romantic without feeling precious, French Mural is equally at home in a traditional dining room, a collected lake house, or a modern space craving a touch of history.

Designed to be left out long after the game is over, it transforms an ordinary table into something worth gathering around.

Like every Tigre de Tartán mat, French Mural is printed on our exclusive PLAYFINISH™ faux leather. Waterproof, wipeable, and engineered to soften the sound of your tiles, it's as practical as it is beautiful.

Every print is illustrated by an independent female artist and crafted to order in the USA and EU.

Features

  • Exclusive custom illustration by an independent female artist
  • Scenic mural-inspired artwork
  • PLAYFINISH™ faux leather exclusive to Tigre de Tartán
  • Waterproof and wipeable

products.title: White Beech Wood Mahjong Racks with Magnetic Pushers + Custom Storage Bag
products.body_html:
A mahjong setup worth showing off. This set of four solid beechwood racks is painted a dreamy matte white and finished with seamless magnetic pushers that click into place with quiet confidence. At 19", they’re long enough to hold both standard and oversized tiles- because you never want to be caught short at the table.

They come packed in a cotton twill logo bag with interior dividers, because thoughtful storage should never be an afterthought. It’s all included. Chic, functional, and satisfying to use—this set is made for players with serious style.

These racks are made from real wood and individually hand-painted, so each one has its own subtle quirks and character. We recommend storing them in their protective sleeve and handling with care to help keep the paint looking pristine.

Details:

  • Set of 4 solid beech wood mahjong racks (19" length)

  • Painted matte white for a clean, classic finish

  • Integrated magnetic pushers glide effortlessly

  • Fits standard and oversized tiles (up to 1.25" wide)

  • Includes custom Tigre de Tartán cotton twill bag with four rack compartments

  • Designed for beauty, durability, and that perfect game-night click

  • A smarter, more considered take on the classic rack

products.title: The Commuter Travel Bundle: Confetti
products.body_html:
Travel sets usually compromise. The Commuter refuses to.

Looking for a Mahj set that fits in something smaller than a duffle bag AND has tiles that are big enough to read? Well, we did too. That's why we designed The Commuter.

A complete system engineered as one: tiles, racks, mat, and bag designed together for portability that doesn't sacrifice performance. Take your game from apartment to friend's place, office to weekend getaway, home to wherever the best nights happen.

What makes it different:

The tiles are obsession worthy, translucent acrylic with confetti iridescent finish. Slightly smaller. Much, much lighter. Properly engineered for travel, allowing you to play where you want.

The system fits together intelligently. Racks nest for compact storage. Mat rolls without creasing. Bag holds everything with room for your cards, keys wallet and maybe a can of champagne. Every component designed to work together, not thrown together.

Includes:
160 Mahj Pit tiles (and tile bag)

Dice set

4 - 13 inch wooden racks

Premium playing mat (22" x 22")

Custom carry bag to fit everything

All the quality, all the engineering, all portable

Specs: Tiles: 0.79 x 1.26 x 0.5 in   |  Complete system weight: ~3 lbs

Pack the pit. The game goes where you go.
